nondeterminism_explanation: Gemini 3.5-flash-lite on crop batch splits produces different JSON structures and classifications depending on context candidates. In some batches, background elements like logo (T030 OMEGA) or scoreboards (T041 20000.0s) are correctly classified as scene_text/ui (is_subtitle=False). Due to lack of visual coherence in batch prompting, in other runs, the model hallucinates surrounding dialog subtitles into these tracks, classifying them as is_subtitle=True. Offline checks like PaddleOCR asymmetric rejection are critical to correct this variance.
